facts.text: Serve the mains when Nacho finally cooks the orphans a proper feast.
facts.why: The plot says Nacho uses his wrestling pay to improve the orphans' lives and finally buys the monastery a bus, but no single proper feast scene is described. The printed card shows the same cue.
facts.fix: Serve the mains when Nacho spends his first wrestling pay on better food for the orphans.

facts.text: By day I cook for the orphans. Tonight the chips are fresh, so please eat before Esqueleto does.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Nacho's words, but it is not a line from the film. The chip joke fits, since Steven (Esqueleto) is the thief who robs Nacho of the orphanage's chips. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: By day I cook for the orphans. Tonight the chips are fresh, so eat before Esqueleto gets to them.

vibe.verdict: The canteen timetable and tiny prices are a clever fit for a monastery kitchen, but the film's best lines and the fights are barely used.
